description.p: croc is a command-line tool for sending files and folders between computers. It supports end-to-end encryption, transfer resumption, and direct connections with relay fallback.

This community package uses the official Linux release. Run flatpak run io.github.schollz.Croc send FILE to send, or flatpak run io.github.schollz.Croc to enter a receive code. The application menu opens a terminal where you can use the croc command. Update this package through Flatpak. The upstream updater helper is included as flatpak run --command=croc-update io.github.schollz.Croc; it cannot replace the read-only Flatpak installation.

Files in your home directory are accessible. External drives are not included: enable them with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media io.github.schollz.Croc or flatpak override --user --filesystem=/mnt io.github.schollz.Croc. Reset custom permissions with flatpak override --user --reset io.github.schollz.Croc. The sandbox has its own private /tmp.
